summary: RETEST of Word invoice download on /admin/orders PASSES end-to-end. The download-invoice-word button now appears in the expanded order action row of AdminOrdersPage.js (route /admin/orders, reached via the global header 'Заказы' link). Verified for 2 different orders: clicking the button fires GET /api/admin/orders/{id}/invoice, both return HTTP 200 with Content-Type 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document', and the browser receives a .docx download (filenames: Счет_f8c49f31.docx, Счет_1a88a08f.docx). No error toasts shown.

downloadInvoice handler (lines 111-123) duplicates the same logic that presumably still exists in AdminPage.js (orphaned dialog from prev iter). Extracting into a shared <InvoiceDownloadButton orderId=... /> component would prevent future drift, and the dead orphaned block in AdminPage.js should be removed.
downloadInvoice error path only fires toast.error('Ошибка скачивания счёта') — does not surface the underlying HTTP status/detail for debugging. Minor.
